content: We experiment with the 3 best methods (TYC, AutoEncoder and HotFlip) on 2 accuracy thresholds (T0 and T2), using BiLSTM$+$A as the classifier. For each method and threshold, we randomly sample 25 positive-to-negative and 25 negative-to-positive examples. To control for quality, we reserve and annotate 10% of the samples ourselves as control questions. Workers are first presented with 10 control questions as a quiz, and only those who pass the quiz with at least 80% accuracy can continue to work on the task. We display 10 questions per page, where one control question is embedded to continue monitor worker performance. The task is designed such that each control question can only be seen once per worker. We restrict our jobs to workers in United States, United Kingdoms, Australia, and Canada.
